correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the full minimax problem. Symmetry reduces every candidate Euclidean form to \(H_\rho\); Hölder duality proves the conjugate Day-James norm equals its antinorm; this forces \(m_\rho M_\rho=(1-\rho^2)^{-1}\). The calculus lemmas prove a unique balance point and strict monotonicity of the distortion on both sides. Endpoint regimes are separately bounded, so the balance is a global, not local, optimum. The checks at \(p=3\) and \(p=4\) agree symbolically.
